description.narrative:
The project aims to influence attitudes and practices on climate change among students and educators from rural public schools in Nigeria and Hungary. It seeks to promote climate change literacy, sustainability, and environmental stewardship among seniorsecondaryschool students, educators, and institutions.
SEA will engage with schools in rural areas within these countries, ensuring that these marginalized populations have access to climate change education and sustainability opportunities. It will be implemented through a multifaceted approach including workshops collaboratively executed by PYDI <(>&<)> CoMetta in the schools, which will be followed by the institution of Sustainability clubs, after which students will begin to get in-depth knowledge and understanding on the subject facilitating the development <(>&<)> execution of a sustainability project in their communities , during the period of the running of sustainability clubs, educators will receive virtual capacity building trainings.
The SEA project aims to strengthen sustainability education in secondary schools by equipping teachers and students with practical knowledge, systems thinking tools, and embodied learning approaches. The core objective is to work with 20 schools to increase awareness,motivation, and agency among students and educators in order to shift attitudes around what is essential for sustainability education in the 21st century. We aim to establish sustainability clubs, organize capacity building workshops for educators and students.
In the short term, the project will deliver interactive workshops for teachers and students, introducing topics such as climate impact, systems thinking, climate career pathways, circular economy, emotional resilience, and embodiment. These topics will be further deepened through the sustainability clubs, allowing students and teachers to develop a deeper understanding of sustainability challenges and current pathways for action.
In the longer term, we aim for institutional change by embedding sustainability more deeply within school cultures. By targeting both students and educators, the project supports sustained engagement with sustainability education by contributing financial support,facilitation, and information for youth-led projectsthrough the sustainability clubs. We also aim to make future careers in climate-related fields more realistic for students.

participating-org.narrative:
Youth underdevelopment remains a significant challenge in Africa, hindering the potential of futures and future generations. Despite efforts, limited access to quality education, economic opportunities, and leadership development perpetuates poverty, inequality, and social instability. With the youth population projected to double by 2050, prioritizing investments in their development and supporting initiatives that empower them is crucial to shaping a prosperous future for the continent.
Primacy youth development initiative is a youth led and focused non profit organization that is headquartered in Lagos , Nigeria, with our program reach and impacting thousands of young people across 34 African countries.
Our Vision: To impact youths and build prosperous societies
Mission: We are on a mission to empower 10 million African youths through a multifaceted delivery approach to practical, skill-oriented education that bridges the gap between theory and industry needs, driving employability, prosperity, and sustainable growth across the continent.
Core Values: H: Hope E: Excellence A: Altruism R: Respect T: Team work <(>&<)> Transparency
Our focus: Mentorship Collaboration SDG Advocacy Community building Job <(>&<)> Economic opportunities Futures <(>&<)> future generations Career orientation Leadership development
